ground_truth.rationale: The new CR2-BM DOF guard can emit a non-finite df, but downstream inference callers only reject df <= 0 (not non-finite df), so a guarded BM DOF can still yield finite or silently-fallback inference fields - violating the all-or-nothing NaN inference contract (safe_inference).
